title: Nourishing German Semolina Pudding
description: A comforting dessert made with semolina flour and a touch of Vietnamese inspiration. This nourishing treat is perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: pho spice blend
ingredients.notes: Vietnamese pho spice blend for added depth

instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together semolina flour and sugar.
Gradually add in milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in eggs and vanilla extract.
Pour mixture into a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of pho spice blend. Enjoy!
